method: Static TypeScript AST/module-resolution inspection. This is not browser verification.
limitations: Imports and source references prove static coupling, not a rendered interaction or permission path.
No browser screenshots, accessibility run, dark-mode interaction test, package installation, bundle measurement, database, provider, or deployment action was performed.
The 58 count is page files, not a count of database-populated URLs generated by dynamic routes.

slugSources: published article and case-study records when DATABASE_URL is configured
arabicCatchAllResolution.scope: Static resolver patterns only; dynamic content records are not counted as separate routes.

graphSemantics.directRuntimeModuleConsumers: One runtime import or runtime re-export resolves directly to this source module. Type-only imports are excluded.
graphSemantics.connectedPageOrLayoutModules: Transitive consumers that are app page.tsx or layout.tsx entry modules. The reverse graph resolves relative imports, @/ alias imports, index modules, export-star and named runtime re-exports; modulePath is consumer-to-source and does not claim a symbol-level render relationship.

themeSources.preservation: Public gold and administration gold are distinct existing source tokens; this inventory does not unify them.
